booth: Painted enamel green, Midway's own colour: the AuthShell panel behind sign-in. `primary` and `sidebar` share its value in light. Carries `ticket` (7.4:1 light, 8.2:1 dark) and `sidebar-foreground` (9.9:1, 9.5:1).
booth-deep: Deeper enamel. Declared in app.css and painted nowhere yet: keep it for a pressed or shadowed booth surface, never for text. In dark it sits almost on the page ground.
ticket: Ticket-stock yellow, the one bright note: the MIDWAY wordmark, the live StatusChip and, in dark, every primary action. As a fill it takes #14211e ink (9.9:1). As text, only Anton numerals on `booth` or `sidebar` (7.4:1 light, 8.2:1 dark). The mobile header breaks that rule. It sets the 20px wordmark in `ticket` on `background`, 1.6:1 in light, far under the 4.5:1 floor; kept exact from the source. Dark reads 10.9:1.
flag: Painted red, destructive only. Declared for the palette; components reach it through `destructive`, which holds the same value in both themes.
background: The page ground: the console, the form side of AuthShell, the closed-booth page. Its two values also paint the browser chrome (theme-color meta).
foreground: Body text and headings on `background` (15.9:1 light, 14.6:1 dark), `card`, `popover` and hovered rows. The live StatusChip hard-codes the light value, #14211e, as its ink in both themes.
card: Raised surface. Only the unused Card primitive paints it: Midway lays panels flat on `background` with a hairline instead.
popover-foreground: Text in toasts and menus (16.6:1 light, 12.9:1 dark).
primary: The one action a view is for: Create campaign, Save changes, Sign in. Booth green in light, ticket yellow in dark. One primary Button per view.
primary-foreground: Label on a `primary` fill (11.9:1 light, 9.9:1 dark).
secondary: Quiet fill: the secondary Button variant (unused today) and the Sheet's close button while open.
muted: Recessed fills: the ended StatusChip, row hover at 60%, the leads table header at 50%.
muted-foreground: Secondary text: intros, list meta, hints, captions, table headers. Reads on `background` (5.4:1 light, 7.3:1 dark), `card` (5.6:1, 6.5:1) and `muted` (4.9:1, 5.9:1).
accent: Hover fill for ghost and outline Buttons. Same value as `secondary`.
destructive: Errors and irreversible actions: the :user-invalid border and message under a field (4.6:1 light, 5.5:1 dark), and the form error alert, which sets this colour on a 10% tint of itself. That alert reads 4.0:1 in light, under the 4.5:1 floor for its 14px text; kept exact from the source. Dark reads 5.0:1.
destructive-foreground: The declared pair for text on `destructive` (4.6:1 light, 5.0:1 dark). The destructive Button uses white instead: 4.8:1 on the light fill, 6.8:1 on dark's 60% fill.
border: Hairlines: panel outlines, list and ScoreStrip dividers, the Sheet edge, dashed empty states. 1.35:1 on `background` in light, 1.6:1 in dark: structure, never the only sign of a control.
input: Borders of inputs and native selects. 1.35:1 on `background` in light and 1.87:1 in dark, under the 3:1 floor for control boundaries; kept exact from the source. The label above each control and the shadow-xs lift carry the affordance.
ring: Keyboard focus. A focused control gets a solid `ring` border (11.9:1 light, 10.9:1 dark) plus a 3px halo at 50%. The halo alone reads 2.8:1 in light and 3.6:1 in dark, so the solid border is what carries the indicator.
sidebar: The console sidebar and the mobile menu sheet. Booth green in light, near-black enamel in dark.
sidebar-foreground: Sidebar and AuthShell text: 9.9:1 on `sidebar` in light, 12.2:1 in dark. Nav links rest at 80% (6.9:1, 8.2:1); the signed-in email sits at 60% (4.6:1, 5.2:1), the floor for its 12px size.
sidebar-primary: The MIDWAY wordmark on the sidebar, 24px: 7.4:1 light, 10.5:1 dark.
sidebar-primary-foreground: Text on a `sidebar-primary` fill. No component paints one yet.
sidebar-accent: The active nav link's fill, and every nav link's hover.
sidebar-accent-foreground: Active and hovered nav link text (10.2:1 light, 14.1:1 dark).
sidebar-border: The rule above the signed-in email at the foot of the sidebar.
sidebar-ring: Focus ring on sidebar links, ticket yellow: 7.4:1 light, 10.5:1 dark.
